messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Triplet: ["Mounjaro", "manufacturer", "Eli Lilly and Company"]

The relation 'manufacturer' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is produced or manufactured by the company specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'manufactured by': The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.
B. 'has brand name': The subject drug is marketed under the brand or trade name specified by the object entity.
C. 'manufacturer parent company': The company that manufactures the subject drug is a subsidiary or part of the parent company specified by the object entity.
D. 'has formulation': The subject drug is available in the specific formulation specified by the object entity.
E. 'has generic versions manufactured by': The generic versions of the subject drug are manufactured by the companies specified by the object entity.
